title: Forward worker logs with per-worker identifiers
description: Forward worker stdout/stderr to serve stdout/stderr while tagging each line with worker id; JSON logs should be augmented with worker_id field, non-JSON prefixed.

title: Forward worker output with per-line tagging
description:
## Context
Add worker stdout/stderr forwarding in the serve command, tagging each line with a worker id and injecting worker_id into JSON logs.

## Key Changes
- `src/Command/ServeCommand.php` - add output callback, per-worker per-stream buffers, line splitting, and forwarding.

## Patterns to Follow
- Follow supervision loop and worker lifecycle in `src/Command/ServeCommand.php`.
- Use JSON log patterns from `tests/Fixtures/app/src/StdoutJsonLogger.php`.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] JSON log lines include `extra.worker_id` and preserve existing fields.
- [ ] Non-JSON lines are prefixed with `[worker N] ` and forwarded to correct stream.
- [ ] Ordering is preserved per worker stream.
- [ ] Tests pass: `vendor/bin/phpunit`.

## References
- Full plan: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-0c5/plan.md`
- Research: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-0c5/research.md`

title: Make test log parsing tolerant of non-JSON lines
description:
## Context

## Key Changes

## Patterns to Follow
- Preserve warning checks in `assertNoWarnings()` for parsed JSON records only.
- Keep incremental output parsing behavior in `ConsoleProcessSession::collectRecords()`.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Non-JSON lines no longer throw in test harness.
- [ ] JSON log lines still parsed into records with level/message/context.
- [ ] Warning-level JSON logs still fail tests.
- [ ] Tests pass: `vendor/bin/phpunit`.

## References

title: Fix CoversClass annotations in ProcessCommandTest
description: ProcessCommandTest has CoversClass(ConsoleProcessRunner::class) but the test class is testing ServeCommand behavior. CoversClass should reference the production classes being tested: ServeCommand, WorkerOutputFormatter, etc.

title: Deduplicate test support code
description: assertNoWarnings() is copy-pasted in both ConsoleProcessRunner and ConsoleProcessSession. waitForStdoutJsonLine() and waitForStdoutLine() in ProcessCommandTest are structurally identical. JSON log record parsing is duplicated between ConsoleProcessRunner::parseJsonLogs and ConsoleProcessSession::collectRecords. Extract shared logic into dedicated helpers.

title: Refactor command classes for PSR-4/SRP compliance
description: Split oversized command classes (including serve and similar) into PSR-4-aligned, single-responsibility classes without changing runtime behavior.

title: Add messenger worker manager with restart policy and E2E coverage
description: Add a manager that spawns multiple Symfony Messenger workers with expected/unexpected restart logic, graceful SIGTERM handling, and end-to-end tests for restart/shutdown scenarios.

title: Supervisor core + command behavior
description:
## Context
Implement the core pm:serve supervisor loop that spawns and manages multiple Messenger workers, applies restart/backoff policy, and handles SIGTERM for graceful shutdown.

## Key Changes
- `src/Command/ServeCommand.php` - replace stub with supervisor loop, worker tracking, restart policies, and SIGTERM forwarding.
- `src/Resources/config/services.yaml` - keep command registration (no new services unless needed).

## Patterns to Follow
- Use `Symfony\\Component\\Process\\Process` for spawning and managing child processes (see `tests/Support/ConsoleProcessRunner.php:37`).
- All output must go through logger (JSON stdout only); avoid direct stdout writes to keep E2E log parsing intact (`tests/Support/ConsoleProcessRunner.php:95`).

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Workers spawn and are tracked with restart behavior.
- [ ] Expected exit (code 0) restarts immediately without limit.
- [ ] Unexpected exit applies exponential backoff and stops after retry limit in window.
- [ ] SIGTERM stops respawns, forwards SIGTERM to workers, exits after workers stop.
- [ ] No stdout output besides JSON logger lines.

## References
- Full plan: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-3cc/plan.md`
- Research: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-3cc/research.md`

title: Messenger dependency + fixture wiring
description:
## Context
Add Messenger and Process as runtime dependencies and configure the fixture Symfony app so E2E tests can run real Messenger workers.

## Key Changes
- `composer.json` - add `symfony/messenger` to `require`; move `symfony/process` to `require`.
- `tests/Fixtures/app/config/packages/framework.yaml` - enable Messenger with test transport and `stop_worker_on_signals`.
- `tests/Fixtures/app/src` - add message class, handler, and a console command to dispatch the message for tests.

## Patterns to Follow
- Keep fixture app minimal; use existing fixture config style (`tests/Fixtures/app/config/services.yaml`).
- Logger must remain JSON stdout only (see `tests/Fixtures/app/src/StdoutJsonLogger.php:13`).

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Composer dependencies updated for runtime Messenger usage.
- [ ] Fixture Messenger config loads without warnings.
- [ ] Console command can dispatch a test message for worker consumption.

## References
- Full plan: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-3cc/plan.md`
- Research: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-3cc/research.md`

title: End-to-end tests
description:
## Context
Add E2E tests for pm:serve supervision behavior and extend the test harness timeout to cover backoff scenarios.

## Key Changes
- `tests/E2E/ProcessCommandTest.php` - expand to include expected exit restarts, unexpected exit backoff/limit, kill + restart, and graceful shutdown.
- `tests/Support/ConsoleProcessRunner.php` - increase `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` to accommodate backoff.
- `tests/E2E` - add additional test file if needed for isolation.

## Patterns to Follow
- Use JSON log parsing and no stdout output assumptions (`tests/Support/ConsoleProcessRunner.php:78`).
- Keep tests deterministic; prefer explicit waits and bounded timeouts.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Tests cover expected exit restart, unexpected exit backoff/limit, kill + restart, SIGTERM shutdown.
- [ ] Updated timeout prevents flakiness while staying reasonable.
- [ ] PHPUnit passes.

## References
- Full plan: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-3cc/plan.md`
- Research: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-3cc/research.md`

title: Inject output streams in WorkerOutputHandler
description: WorkerOutputHandler::forwardLine() writes directly to STDOUT/STDERR global streams. Accept output stream resources via constructor. In production pass STDOUT/STDERR, in tests pass php://memory or a spy. Standard dependency inversion for testability.

title: Extract event loop from ServeCommand::execute()
description: execute() is ~155 lines containing input parsing, signal registration, worker init, the entire event loop, process start, output forwarding, exit handling, failure tracking, backoff calculation, shutdown coordination. Extract a ProcessManagerLoop class. The command should parse input, construct the loop, and call loop->run(). Each iteration concern should be its own method.

title: Add clock abstraction for backoff logic
description: ServeCommand calls microtime(true) directly throughout. Backoff calculation, failure window pruning, and restart scheduling are tied to wall-clock time, making them impossible to unit test without real waits. Inject Symfony ClockInterface (PSR-20) so unit tests can advance time synthetically.

title: Setup Symfony bundle skeleton with PHPStan and E2E test infrastructure
description: Prepare repository for Symfony bundle development: bundle skeleton structure, PHPStan static analysis configuration, and E2E test setup with sample Symfony application

title: Fix log level semantics in ServeCommand
description: Every log call in ServeCommand uses info level, including failure events like 'Worker failure limit reached' and backoff restarts. Use warning for unexpected exits with backoff, error for failure limit reached / forced shutdown, info for normal lifecycle events. Also make assertNoWarnings in test helpers opt-in per test rather than blanket.

title: Add PHP-CS-Fixer with PER-CS 2.0 config
description: No automated code formatting tool is configured. There are minor inconsistencies (brace placement, increment style). Adopt PHP-CS-Fixer or ECS with PER-CS 2.0 (the PSR-12 successor). Formatting should be enforced in CI. Add composer require --dev friendsofphp/php-cs-fixer and commit a .php-cs-fixer.dist.php config.

title: Run CLI command in separate process and assert warning/error logs
description: Run a bundle CLI command in a separate process during tests and parse logs to fail on LoggerInterface::warning or higher.

title: Bundle command + fixture logger wiring
description:
## Context
Add the bundle `pm:serve` command and wire it via bundle DI. In the fixture app, override `Psr\Log\LoggerInterface` with a lightweight stdout JSON logger and import fixture services.

## Key Changes
- `src/Command/ServeCommand.php` - implement `pm:serve` command (no args) and log via LoggerInterface only.
- `src/DependencyInjection/SymfonyProcessManagerExtension.php` - load bundle services config.

- `tests/Fixtures/app/src/StdoutJsonLogger.php` - lightweight stdout JSON logger.
- `tests/Fixtures/app/config/services.yaml` - override LoggerInterface to use the fixture logger.
- `tests/Fixtures/app/Kernel.php` - import `config/services.yaml`.

## Patterns to Follow
- Bundle extension load is currently empty: `src/DependencyInjection/SymfonyProcessManagerExtension.php`.
- Fixture kernel imports only packages: `tests/Fixtures/app/Kernel.php`.

## Success Criteria

title: Improve timeout exception messages in test helpers
description: RuntimeException thrown in test helpers has minimal context. waitForRecord throws 'Timed out waiting for log record' but does not include what records were seen, timeout duration, or process stderr. Include diagnostic context in timeout exceptions.

title: Extract WorkerState behavior from ServeCommand
description: WorkerState is a bag of public mutable fields. The command directly mutates process, stopped, stopSignalSent, failureTimestamps, nextStartAt. State transitions should be methods on WorkerState (e.g. recordFailure(), scheduleRestart(), markStopped()). This makes the state machine testable independently and reduces execute() to orchestration.

title: Extract signal state from closure variables
description: The SIGTERM handler mutates two variables via closure references (&shutdownRequested, &shutdownReason). This does not scale for additional signals and is hard to test. Extract into a small ShutdownState object that the signal handler writes to and the loop reads from.

title: Add unit tests for WorkerOutputFormatter
description: WorkerOutputFormatter is a pure function (string in, string out) with no test of its own. Edge cases (malformed JSON, nested extra keys, empty strings, very long lines) go unverified. Add targeted unit tests.

title: Add composer scripts for common tasks
description: No composer.json scripts section. Add scripts: test, analyse, cs, cs-fix, check (runs analyse + test). Standard practice for Symfony bundles.

title: Add declare(strict_types=1) to all PHP files
description: No file in the codebase declares strict_types. Every PHP file must begin with declare(strict_types=1). PHPStan at level max catches many type issues statically, but strict_types catches them at runtime too.
